tasks.description: D027. Scope and priorities come from the M4-16 audit.
acceptanceCriteria: styles.css defines colours, type scale, spacing, radii and shadows as CSS custom properties, and no colour literal appears outside the token blocks (a check script, run by the UI tests).
Light and dark themes follow prefers-color-scheme, with a toggle that persists; in both themes axe reports no serious or critical violations, colour contrast included, on every tab (tests/ui).
At 390, 1024 and 1440 px wide no tab scrolls horizontally, and the sidebar collapses on narrow screens (tests/ui).
Every navigation item and control is reachable with Tab and shows a visible focus ring (tests/ui).
Each M4-16 P1 finding owned by this task is resolved, with before/after screenshots in the report; the bundle stays under its gzipped ceiling (check-package).

tasks.title: Dashboard performance on large workspaces
tasks.objective: Make the dashboard load and render large graphs faster, with targets set from the M4-16 baseline.
tasks.description: D027. Candidates: lazy-load the layout engines (elk, cola, dagre, fcose) on first use, compress and trim API payloads, render large graphs progressively.
acceptanceCriteria: The initial gzipped JavaScript the dashboard loads is at least 30% smaller than the M4-16 baseline (check-package and the report).

On the ~2,000-node fixture, time to an interactive graph is at least 30% below the M4-16 baseline, and no main-thread task during loading exceeds the target set in the report (tests/ui/perf.spec.ts, Performance API).
/api/graph for that fixture is served compressed and at least 30% smaller on the wire than the baseline (test).

tasks.objective: The dashboard shows every registered repo: a workspace overview, a repo switcher, and repo-scoped views, with cross-repo edges marked.
tasks.description: D027. The UI server reads only the primary repo (config.repo) for clusters, profile, smells, DSM and metrics.

Clusters, profile, smells, DSM, metrics, symbols, routes and the graph accept ?repo=<name> (default: as documented), each tested on the 3-repo fixture.

The dashboard has a repo switcher (All plus each repo), kept in the URL, and a workspace overview; switching repo changes the graph to that repo's files, and cross-repo edges are drawn distinctly (tests/ui).

tasks.objective: The dashboard shows the effective configuration: repos, include and exclude patterns, parse workers, PHP facade map, HTTP clients and hosts, user languages. Each value is marked default or user-set, with validation warnings.

tasks.title: Cross-repo HTTP communication view in the dashboard
tasks.objective: Show how repos talk over HTTP: frontend call sites paired with backend routes and handlers, unmatched calls, and a repo-to-repo flow, as for majles's frontend and backend.
tasks.description: D027. Builds on M2 HTTP pairing (http edges, .mapx/http-calls.json, mapx routes --clients).
acceptanceCriteria: /api/http returns the client call sites (file, line, method, URL, client), their matched route and handler (file, symbol, repo), and unmatched calls, per repo pair; on a synthetic two-repo fixture (Vue/axios frontend, Laravel backend) the pairs and unmatched calls equal mapx routes --clients --json and --unmatched (tests/ui-server.test.ts).
An HTTP tab lists the pairs with filters (method, repo pair, matched or unmatched) and a repo-to-repo flow diagram weighted by pair counts; selecting a pair shows both source locations (tests/ui).
The graph view marks http edges between repos (tests/ui).

A cyclic-dependency smell for files a -> b -> a, where a also has an edge to itself, describes a -> b -> a and lists a and b; a file with only an edge to itself raises no cycle smell (tests/architecture-data.test.ts, real scan).

The codebase profile lists a framework only when it is detected in a folder outside graphExcludePatterns; a Laravel app under tests/fixtures alone no longer appears in detectedFrameworks, while route extraction for it is unchanged (test).
